pipelines.name: ci

steps.run: pnpm -C "${{ matrix.package }}" exec playwright install --with-deps chromium

steps.name: Ensure all CI jobs succeeded
steps.run:
if [[ "${{ needs.lint.result }}" != "success" \
  || "${{ needs.typecheck.result }}" != "success" \
  || "${{ needs.unit-test.result }}" != "success" \
  || "${{ needs.e2e.result }}" != "success" \
  || "${{ needs.browser-test.result }}" != "success" ]]; then
  echo "One or more CI jobs failed."
  exit 1
fi
